title: Out of Home Advertising | Vistar Media Homepage

facts.fact: Vistar Media's homepage says it facilitates serendipity in out-of-home advertising hundreds of thousands of times a day (vendor's own claim, not independently verified).
facts.quote: At Vistar Media, we facilitate that serendipity hundreds of thousands of times a day.

facts.fact: Vistar's Creative Studio says it has designed out-of-home ads for more than 10 years (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: For more than 10 years, Vistar’s Creative Studio has designed ads for the real world, from dynamic creative that shifts with place and moment to immersive 3D.

facts.fact: Vistar Media's homepage lists an award image labeled Media Plan Awards 2020 among its recognitions (vendor-displayed award, not a verified third-party figure).
Vistar Media says its out-of-home advertising is blended into landscapes across cities including Auckland, Montreal, Tampa and Zurich (vendor's own description of its reach).
facts.quote: blended into the landscapes from Auckland to Montreal to Tampa to Zurich.
